tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check the authenticated Oceanir account's current credit balance and remaining monthly allowance.

tools.name: list_past_scenes
tools.description: List this account's past Oceanir results, newest first: place, coordinates, confidence, depth and date. Read-only: it never runs a new analysis and never spends credits. tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List this account's cases (named groups of results), newest first, with their ids. Read-only: it never runs an analysis and never spends credits.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Read a case's summary: what it holds, the results attached to it and where they point. Read-only: it never runs an analysis and never spends credits. tools.name: create_case
tools.description: Create an empty case to group related results. Free: it spends no credits. Returns the new case's id.

tools.name: add_scene_to_case
tools.description: Analyze one image and attach the result to an existing case. Spends credits at the usual rates (D1 1, D2 2, D3 10). tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read the last 30 days of Oceanir usage for the authenticated account: calls, credits used, a breakdown by depth, and what remains. Read-only; it never spends credits.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
